name: Calhoun County, AL
findings: Calhoun County has 240 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Calhoun County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 15 would.

observations.text: 37 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
